mapper.select: SELECT competition.id, name, review_begin_time, review_end_time, IF(#{code} = JSON_OBJECT(review_settings, '$.0'), ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE review.accept IS NOT NULL AND review.com_id = competition.id AND review.user_code NOT IN (SELECT user.code FROM user WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_KEYS(review_settings), CONCAT('$.',user.dep_id))))), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE review.accept IS NOT NULL AND review.com_id = competition.id AND review.user_code IN (SELECT user.code FROM user WHERE user.dep_id = #{dep_id}))) AS 'completed_num', IF(#{code} = JSON_OBJECT(review_settings, '$.0'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE review.com_id = competition.id AND review.user_code NOT IN (SELECT user.code FROM user WHERE JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(review_settings,'one', CONCAT('$.',user.dep_id)))), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE review.com_id = competition.id AND review.user_code IN (SELECT user.code FROM user WHERE user.dep_id = #{dep_id}))) AS 'total_num' FROM competition WHERE is_review = 1 AND review_settings LIKE '%' #{code} '%' ORDER BY review_begin_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE accept IS NOT NULL
